scope: Three-minute elapsed deadline across local attachment reading and SHA-256 for editor and recipient checks. Late reads cannot start hashing; late hashes cannot return metadata.
coverage: Six focused cases cover timer, wall and monotonic expiry during reading or digesting, including backwards wall time and explicit fresh retry.
Existing editor tests retain cancellation, unmount and metadata-change generation guards.
Existing desktop/mobile flow verifies real file hashing, draft recovery, encrypted reporting and vendor file comparison; deadline injection is unit-level.
limits: Original file bytes are still exchanged separately and are not uploaded or included in encrypted backups.
Underlying file/crypto work is not cancelled; expiry prevents subsequent progress and acceptance.
No new full regression, native-wallet or runtime image refresh.
